observations: The sizing prose describes KOReader scaleBySize(px) using px times the short edge divided by 600, yielding x2.06 on Paperwhite and x3.10 on Scribe. Copying that scheme would make Scribe elements 1.5 times larger. The reference instead uses physical sizing with only x1.15 enlargement for Scribe because it is held farther from the eyes, allocating the additional area to more columns and two side-by-side columns.
